name: proveml-paper1-review
description: The Vera review of ProveML paper 1: the build, its adapters, and the records that make the page reproducible.

scripts.build: node build.mjs && node artifact-gate.mjs report/review-page.html && node stream-infer.mjs report/review-page-artifact.html
scripts.anchor: node anchor-hedera.mjs && node anchor-rekor.mjs && node anchor-vana.mjs
scripts.verify: node anchor-hedera.mjs --verify && node anchor-rekor.mjs --verify && node anchor-vana.mjs --verify && node sign-review.mjs --verify
